name: planned_arrival_min
description: Scheduled arrival in the dispatched plan

name: actual_arrival_min
description: Actual arrival (geofence entry, or driver app when the geofence missed)

name: actual_departure_min
description: Actual departure (geofence exit, or driver app)

name: dwell_min
description: Time on site: departure minus arrival

name: gps_stop_lat
description: Latitude where the truck actually parked (telematics stop detection)

name: gps_stop_lon
description: Longitude where the truck actually parked

name: on_time
description: On time under the Retail or Restaurant OTD policy of the customer

name: exception_code
description: NONE, TRAFFIC, WEATHER, DOCK_BUSY, LATE_DISPATCH, REFUSED
